Options like:
- Enable/disable downvote button.
- Subverse header.

- Subverse body background image/colour.
- etc

In subverse settings, there should be 2 tabs (similar to the Hot, New, etc. tabs), Settings and Style.

Subverses you're subscribed to

Media

As the title says; what keeps you motivated? Most people find it easy to get motivated, and begin on projects, but often fall short when push comes to shove, and it starts becoming more and more tedious. What do you do, when you hit "the wall", how do you keep enjoying your new hobby/pastime/workout?

I like to keep track of my progress, as it helps me see my improvement. If it's working out, I take progress pictures fortnightly. If it's drawing, I keep my old drawings in a scrapbook, and look through them when I feel down about my artistic skills. This usually helps me through the roughest period, until it all becomes a habit, and I don't need to be re-energized. Also, keep your work area clean, prepped and ready, it's so easy to shrug something off, because "it's too messy, I can't work like this".

I like what you said about keeping the work area clean, so true. Personally I have found that even the smallest things can stop my motivation, so I take care of every detail in advance. Motivation can be a fragile thing!

When I stop making progress I completely lose my motivation. It helps to have several projects I work on at the same time, so when I face an obstacle that doesn't seems to have a solution, I jump on another project. When I'm completely out of motivation I take a break, empty my mind going outside, meeting friends, try something new.

I don't know what exactly keeps me motivated and I wouldn't even say that I am always motivated. I often find myself looking back at things I accomplished and think to myself "just how the hell did you do that?".
